name: Victoria
message: 「Take that！ Hah！」
We heard the stadium was being used, so we all came to check it out, and—
the current Toujinegi was already in the middle of a match there.

name: Victoria
message: 「Next up is... something like this, I guess！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Yeah, that’s pretty good. Keep it up like that.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Then, here I go, one after another！」
It seemed this wasn't a serious bout, but some kind of special training.
Even so, perhaps because it was the current Toujinegi's training, many other students were gathered to watch.
Maybe because of that, the current Toujinegi—Victoria-san—was clearly in higher spirits than when she fought Momiji before.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Next, right here. Please hit the spot where I’m guarding now. Then keep going to the left and right.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Okie-dokie！ Something like this, maybe！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I see... Alright, next the other side. And then immediately aim for the same spot as before.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Leave it to me！ Hyah！」

name: Asahi
message: 「The targets are being designated, but... her strikes are as sharp as ever.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Everyone around is getting pretty rowdy, too~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Is that Shizuku-senpai taking the hits? She’s from the Technical Division, right? Isn't that more impressive?」
They were all observing the scene on stage while commenting like that.
However, Miyako-chan was silent for a while, and then she lost interest and stopped watching.

name: Iori
message: 「What’s the matter, Miyako-chan?」

name: Miyako
message: 「That person has strong spiritual power, but... she’s not that good. I think my big sister is stronger than her.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s my little sister for you, she knows what’s up！ There, there, good girl~♪」
Pleased by the praise from Miyako-chan, Momiji happily begins to pat her head.
Well, this isn't a serious match, so regardless of comparisons, it's no surprise she doesn't find it interesting.

name: Miyako
message: 「Hey, Sensei. I’m more interested in the stadium itself. Is it okay if I go walk around？」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s fine, but maybe someone should go with you?」

name: Miyako
message: 「No, I’m fine on my own.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I think it’s fine to let Miyako go by herself. After all, she managed to run away from home and get all the way here.」

name: Iori
message: 「Now that you mention it, yeah. Okay, Miyako-chan, make sure you don't get lost.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Okaay! Well then, I'm off!」
Answering energetically, Miyako―chan ran off. As I watched her retreating back―

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, Muragaki-san and everyone else came too！ Hey, come on, come ooon！」
Spotting us, Victoria-san waved her hand vigorously.

name: Victoria
message: 「Look, Shizu！ Muragaki-san and the others are here to watch！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Y-Yeah, they are...」
Shizuku-san fidgeted, looking embarrassed.

name: Victoria
message: 「Having people watch really gets me pumped up！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「N-Never mind that... Anyway, next I want data on what happens when you take an attack with that Origami.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, Shizu！ Everyone came to watch us, so let's have a normal match already！」

name: Victoria
message: 「We've got an audience here and everything, so we've gotta entertain them！ Right？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「But we're only doing this to collect data, not to put on a show...」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whaaat, no way！ Doing nothing but data collection while everyone's watching totally kills my motivation！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, don't be selfish.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, and besides, you want data on taking hits with this, right？ Then just having a normal match would be faster！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Even so, I don't know if that'll give me the data I want...」

name: Victoria
message: 「Come on, let's have a match! I want everyone to have fun!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「...Sigh, fine. Just for a little while.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yay！ I love you, Shizu！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Honestly, you... All right then, let's have a match simulating fights against the top contenders competing in this year's Martial Festival.」

name: Victoria
message: 「I'm fine with anything as long as we get to have a match！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Then first up... is this person...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Here I come too！ Hiyah！」
This time, Shizuku-san started launching strikes as well.
However, something about Shizuku―san's stance looked familiar―

name: Asahi
message: 「That's the stance of a third-year in the Martial Arts Division named Taiga Igarashi. He's a practitioner of the Yagyu Shinkage-ryu style.」

name: Iori
message: 「Doesn't sound like they're from the same school... so that means she's just imitating it？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm almost certain that's the case. But... it's amazing, isn't it?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I've sparred with Taiga Igarashi several times on Yorishiro-kun, and Minamoto-senpai's movements are exactly like his.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see...」

name: Victoria
message: 「Gotcha！」
When I turned my gaze back to the stage, Victoria had already overwhelmed Shizuku and landed a powerful blow.
However, Shizuku didn't even change her expression, and calmly—

name: Shizuku
message: 「Well, something like this should be fine... Then next is... this one.」
The stance she showed was Iai batto-jutsu.

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay, okay！ I'll fight whatever you've got！」
Without hesitation and without slowing her momentum, she rushed straight toward Shizuku.
Shizuku didn't move. She remained perfectly still in her stance. That didn't change even after the opponent had entered her striking range—

name: Victoria
message: 「Hraaaaagh！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Gyauhn！」
The moment after I thought I saw Shizuku’s body shudder for an instant, Victoria was sent flying.
Waiting for the opponent to attack and then landing a counter; it's a common style in modern Iai batto-jutsu, and Asahi is this type as well.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Doesn't that look a bit like Asahi's style？ Could it be that Asahi's a copycat？」

name: Asahi
message: 「There's no way that's true. Besides, that isn't my form.」

name: Iori
message: 「True, it's slightly more aggressive than Asahi's. That said, you could say the root of it is almost identical.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You're right... It'll be troublesome if this becomes a counter-measure against me.」
She seemed confused, likely not expecting someone to mimic a stance so close to her own.
That said, I found myself genuinely impressed as I watched the match.

name: Iori
message: 「...Still, Shizuku is quite dexterous. Was that the Yagyu Shinkage-ryu earlier?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I wonder if she's the type who can master multiple schools. I haven't seen anyone like that, even in the Martial Arts Division...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But it might be fun to see all kinds of them. I wonder what style is next~」

name: Iori
message: 「No, surely she can't use that many...」
I said with a wry smile, turning my attention back to the match.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hyaaaaah！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Hmph—！」

name: Victoria
message: 「You’re not hitting me anymore！ In exchange, take this！」
Victoria responds instantly to Shizuku’s Iai, maneuvering from a dodge into a counterattack.
Though she took a blow earlier, it seems as though it had no effect at all. ...Well, the same can be said for Shizuku.

name: Victoria
message: 「If I don’t move, everyone will get bored, so how about something like this！」
On a whim, Victoria suddenly rests the hilt of her Origami on the top of her foot and kicks it high into the air.
And the very next instant, she swings her free arm wide and leaps high into the air herself, chasing after the Origami！

name: Victoria
message: 「A secret move I just thought of！ Aerial Combo Dive Attack！」
Catching the kicked-up Origami in mid-air, she plummets back down, guided by gravity.
The reason Shizuku didn't leave the spot immediately was because Victoria had made it look like she was going to throw the Origami.
That was exactly why she stayed put, waiting intently for her to come crashing down—

name: Victoria
message: 「Tenchu！」
Just before landing, she had shifted into a helmet-breaker stance.
She hits the ground with a cloud of dust and a loud crash, drawing huge cheers from the spectators.
Although, Shizuku had easily hopped away right before the attack—or so she thought.

name: Victoria
message: 「Secret technique: Cloud-Hide Slash！」
As if cutting through the rising dust cloud, Victoria suddenly appeared and closed the distance to Shizuku.
Perhaps because her reaction was delayed by the smoke screen of dust, Shizuku couldn't quite intercept her, and they crossed blades in a mutual strike.
When they both pull away, Shizuku shrugs her shoulders.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, you’re being way too reckless...」

name: Victoria
message: 「But everyone is having fun, right？」
In fact, applause was even breaking out from the audience seats.
Though, that didn't seem to impress Shizuku.

name: Shizuku
message: 「My goal is strictly to collect data, after all...」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Regardless, next is this...！」
With that, Shizuku takes up a new stance.
And it’s one that we recognize, too—

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s Momiji-san’s...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So the real copycat was Suzakuin all along！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s not it at all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Doesn't that mean she’s using three different schools？ Can you even do that normally？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, ‘ordinarily’ it’s impossible」
Generally, it is said that learning multiple styles is not a good idea.
Each style has its own philosophy, and the movements that embody that philosophy become the style's swordsmanship.
Even if the swordsmanship itself can be switched, the philosophy is singular, and one cannot reset that at an unconscious level.
Therefore, if you learn multiple forms, the original form will crumble. And the new form won't be mastered either, leaving you unable to use either one.
However, that wasn't the case for Shizuku. She switches completely and masters them.
Though in her case, it seems more like she is tracing the forms rather than learning them—
That is, all the more, proof of extraordinary talent. And that's not all, either—

name: Victoria
message: 「How I’m feeling right now is... three katanas！」
Responding to her voice, the Origami split.
That is her finishing move, which I’ve seen before—

name: Victoria
message: 「—Yugen Mugen, Sonic Rush！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa, all of them were blocked！？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「The defense after that, is here！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Nnnnggghhhhh！」
Not only did she easily block the current Toujinegi's finishing move, she also countered her defense perfectly, as if she could see through everything.
This is unmistakably... Momiji's Shingan no Kiwamete.
Perhaps because it isn't perfect, Victoria managed to leap away and seemingly mitigate some of the damage, but...

name: Shizuku
message: 「Honestly, Vicky... I’ve shown you this many times already. You need to be able to see through it by now.」

name: Victoria
message: 「It’s impossible！ Why are you so accurate！？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「If you’re going to complain, you’ll lose when it counts...」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, that’s fine！ If it’s for real, I’m sure I can win！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Honestly... you’re so sloppy.」

name: Iori
message: 「To be so sure that she’ll be fine when it counts, despite not being able to see through it in practice—she’s an interesting girl.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I wonder where that confidence of hers comes from.」

name: Iori
message: 「Doesn't seem like she’s hiding anything, though.」
As we were talking, Shizuku dropped her stance and began sheathing her Origami.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Well then... I’ve gathered most of the data, so let’s end it here...」

name: Victoria
message: 「Eh—！ No way, I want to do more！ Look, there’s still time left on the facility usage！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「No. Fighting blindly won’t improve your win rate. We need to analyze this data and formulate a strategy.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm... Oh, that’s right！ Everyone from Takamura Class is here now！」
With that, she turns her face toward us watching from the spectator seats.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, hey！ Since you’re watching, you must be free, right？ Someone come have a match with me！」
We were taken aback by the sudden challenge.
But, even while surprised, we all exchanged glances for a moment, and then—

name: Iori
message: 「Sounds fun！」
Nodding to each other, we all headed down onto the stage.

name: Iori
message: 「Thanks for having us. We watched your match, and it was incredible.」
Standing in the same place as the two of them, the first thing I spoke about was the match we’d just witnessed, especially offering praise to Shizuku.

name: Iori
message: 「To think someone who can switch between so many different styles like that is not only among us, but in the Technical Division.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ah, that... I was just doing it to collect data, and I ended up picking them up naturally...」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s impressive in its own right.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But why did you stop halfway？ You looked like you were on the verge of winning against Victoria-senpai！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Well, I was just doing it to gather data in the first place, so whether I won or lost the match didn’t really...」

name: Momiji
message: 「You have no interest in winning or losing... That’s amazing in a different way.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s a perspective that would be impossible for us.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I can’t really wrap my head around that worldview either. I mean, if you lose, you can’t show off, right！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Th-that sort of thing is Vicky’s specialty.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes！ That’s my specialty！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Though, I have to say, Shizu is incredibly strong too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I know, right！ I mean, it was just, like, amazing... so amazing！」

name: Asahi
message: 「The fact that someone from the Technical Division can go toe-to-toe with the current Toujinegi is, quite frankly, something the Martial Arts Division envies.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, I could do even better, though~！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Unfounded confidence will be your downfall.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It is founded！ I’m strong！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Haha, I hope so.」
Asahi and Ririmu lock gazes.

name: Victoria
message: 「Well, even so, I’m not giving Shizu to anyone！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Eep！ Hey, Vicky…！」
Shizuku-san gave a bashful cry after being suddenly hugged.

name: Victoria
message: 「Shizu does all the adjustments for my Origami.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Everything she makes fits me perfectly, and she even spars with me！」

name: Victoria
message: 「She’s my ultimate partner, no doubt about it！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「H-hey, Vicky, you’re exaggerating…！」

name: Victoria
message: 「No way. If anything, it’s not enough！」

name: Victoria
message: 「That’s why I’m going to do my best to win, so I can show off just how amazing Shizu is！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, you two really do seem like the best partners.」

name: Asahi
message: 「It’s just like me and Iori-sensei♪」

name: Iori
message: 「……That’s a tough one to respond to.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, if we’re talking about Sensei’s partner, isn’t that me？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe. You’re quite skilled, being able to talk in your sleep while you’re awake.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hah？ You looking for a fight？ Because I’ll take you up on that—and this spot is perfect for it！」

name: Iori
message: 「Don’t start a random squabble all of a sudden.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ah, wait, wait！ If you want to fight, do it with me！ That’s why I called you all here, after all！」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, that’s right. Who should take her on?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please, let me do it. Opportunities to spar with the current Toujinegi don't come around often.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, if I win here, that practically makes me the Toujinegi, right？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course I want to do it too！ Seeing the fight just now got me all fired up！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, I’ll pass. You can pick from the others.」

name: Iori
message: 「But you said you wanted to fight just a moment ago. Are you sure？」

name: Momiji
message: 「If there were no audience it’d be fine, but I’d rather not reveal my hand in front of this many people~」
I see, that’s a very Momiji-like reason.

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay, so who’s it gonna be？ I’m fine with anyone, but time-wise, I think we only have room for one？」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, then let’s keep it fair… let’s settle this with rock-paper-scissors！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heck yeah, I’m not gonna lose!」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’ll be taking this spot.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「The match against the Toujinegi, I’m definitely gonna be the one to do it!」
